items.title: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX Each Formed a Special Committee to Explore a Merger as His AI Spending Accelerates. Here's Why Combining Them Could Reshape How Investors Value Tesla's Robotaxi Business.
items.summary: A Tesla-SpaceX merger could give the automaker's robotaxi business a boost.

items.title: Jason Calacanis Will “Catch Every Knife” With SpaceX, Tesla and Google. Only Some Are Cheap
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStocks had their worst week of 2026, and angel investor Jason Calacanis said he’ll put any free cash he has into SpaceX, Tesla, Uber, Shopify and Google. He says big tech trades at its lowest P/Es since the dot-com era.

items.title: Tesla Just Started Selling Cybercabs, Here's What It Means for a SpaceX and Tesla Merger .
items.summary: Only a hefty cash premium is likely to satisfy most Tesla investors in the event of a merger, and that premium is likely to rise with a successful robotaxi ramp-up.

items.title: Cathie Wood, Brad Gerstner and 16 Other Big Funds Bought Tesla Last Quarter, While 15 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 18 bought Tesla and 15 sold, with Brad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital and Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest among the buyers.

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Stock Looks Richly Priced After Its 47% Three Year Run
items.summary: Tesla has been busy reshaping its business around robotaxis, humanoid robots and energy projects while the share price has swung sharply, and that leaves a basic question for you as an investor. Is the current US$345.82 price tag adequately backed by what the company is generating through its sales today? items.title: Tesla FSD V15 Rolling Out, Goes 'Wide' Next Month. Elon Musk Says It's 'Something Special.'
items.summary: Tesla Full Self Driving version 15 rolled out to initial FSD users on Saturday. A wide release is planned for next month, CEO Elon Musk said.

items.title: Musk Says Cybercab “Covers About 90%” of Passenger Miles. Tesla’s Next Robotaxi Is a Wheel-Less Model Y
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said at the DealBook Summit that Tesla plans an autonomous Model Y with no steering wheel or pedals, built for groups of six or seven riders. Building robotaxis from Tesla’s most popular car could get it to volume faster than the two-seat Cybercab alone.
